title: latitude_runtime_evidence/v1
description: Public-safe, bounded runtime evidence produced by agent-retrospective's Latitude CLI collector (Issue #2375). This is the ONLY output contract the collector may emit -- collector-internal results are never accepted as arbitrary JSON. additionalProperties: false (top-level and metrics) closes the key set: unknown/forbidden fields (raw trace, prompt, message, tool I/O, full stdout/stderr, authorization, token, secret, absolute local path) fail schema validation rather than being silently dropped. When availability: available, evidence_identity/evidence_ref/metrics.* are required non-null and reason_code is required null. When availability is unavailable or error, evidence_identity/evidence_ref/metrics.* are required null and reason_code is required non-null (from the closed enum below) -- a Latitude-unavailable result never carries an evidence claim. evidence_identity and evidence_ref are both derived (via validate_retrospective_schema.compute_latitude_evidence_ref/compute_latitude_evidence_identity) exclusively from allowlisted metrics/collector_version/collected_at -- never from raw trace ID, raw payload, or a local absolute path (Binding Rules).

evidence_identity.description: sha256 digest of a canonical, public-safe projection (collector_version + evidence_ref + metrics) -- never a hash of raw trace/payload content.

evidence_ref.description: Opaque, non-secret reference derived solely from collector_version + metrics + collected_at. Never raw trace content, a raw trace ID, or a local absolute path.
